create_FloatFunctional: create a FloatFunctional instance to wrap float tensor operations like add, mul, and cat
build_FloatFunctional_add: build a FloatFunctional and use add to compute torch.add(Tensor, Tensor) with activation post-processing
create_FloatFunctional_add_relu: create a FloatFunctional and use add_relu to compute relu(torch.add(x, y)) with activation post-processing
create_QFunctional: create a QFunctional instance to wrap quantized tensor operations like add, mul, and cat with scale and zero_point
build_QFunctional_from_float: build a QFunctional from a FloatFunctional using from_float to convert scale and zero_point for quantized ops
